name: Gloves of the Patient Thief
summary: Gloves that make delicate work and lock picking easier.
description: Nimble, close-fitting, and never worn through. Every thief swears they are only for gardening.

stats.effect: While you wear these gloves, you have Advantage on ability checks made with Thieves' Tools to pick locks or disarm traps, and you have Advantage on Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) checks.
